draft_negotiation_email.subject: Discussion on Catering Quote Ref #RC-2025 & Line Item Clarifications
draft_negotiation_email.body:
Dear Royal Caterers Team,

Thank you for providing the comprehensive proposal for our upcoming celebration in Udaipur. We love the Grand Mewari Royal Dinner Buffet and Live Chaat Street selections.

Upon reviewing the quotation, we noticed that GST (5%) and service charges are currently listed as excluded, and the validity date has lapsed. Given our budget planning across multiple ceremonies for 350 guests, we would like to explore whether an all-inclusive package rate can be extended for the Grand Mewari Royal Buffet and Chaat Street items.

Please let us know if we can schedule a quick 10-minute call to align on these terms.

Warm regards,
Event Planning Team
